_comment: [CMS: brand] Brands Global Nepal Group exports/distributes. Each brand's products live in content/products.json (matched by 'brandSlug'). Add a brand here to create a new brand page at /hardware/<slug>.
name: Zebra
blurb: Zebra Technologies is a global leader in automatic identification and data capture (AIDC) solutions, including barcode scanners, RFID technology, mobile computers, and printers — enhancing workflow efficiency and real-time visibility across retail, healthcare, logistics and manufacturing.

name: Rynan
blurb: Rynan Technologies specializes in innovative printing, coding and packaging solutions — thermal inkjet (TIJ) printers and industrial coding systems for food, pharmaceutical and manufacturing industries, with a focus on eco-friendly, high-performance marking.

name: HID
blurb: HID Global is a leading provider of trusted identity and access management solutions — secure access control, biometrics, RFID technology, identity verification and credential management for government, healthcare, education, finance and enterprise.

name: Yesmark
blurb: Yesmark is a provider of industrial coding, marking and traceability solutions — continuous inkjet (CIJ), thermal inkjet (TIJ), laser marking and high-resolution printing systems for food & beverage, pharmaceuticals, packaging and manufacturing.

name: OEM
blurb: Original-equipment and custom-integrated hardware, specified and sourced for your exact requirement.
